name: palimpsest
description: Evidence-gated research artifact for the Palimpsest distributed decipherment puzzle.

scripts.format: oxfmt --config oxfmt.json --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json oxfmt.json oxlint.json vitest.config.ts packages tools tests specs docs/roadmap.md AGENTS.md python/pyproject.toml && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff format --config python/pyproject.toml python
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --config oxfmt.json --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json oxfmt.json oxlint.json vitest.config.ts packages tools tests specs docs/roadmap.md AGENTS.md python/pyproject.toml && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff format --config python/pyproject.toml --check python
scripts.gate-a:inputs: tsx tools/gate-a/acquire-sources.ts && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.channel.inputs && tsx tools/gate-a/inputs.ts
scripts.gate-a:inputs:offline: uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.channel.inputs && tsx tools/gate-a/inputs.ts
scripts.gate-b:inputs: tsx tools/gate-b/acquire-sources.ts && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.solver_packets --policies && tsx tools/gate-b/inputs.ts
scripts.gate-b:inputs:offline: uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.solver_packets --policies && tsx tools/gate-b/inputs.ts
scripts.gate-b:build: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.instance_producer --all && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.solver_packets --all
scripts.gate-b:admit: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --frozen --project python --env-file .env.local python -m palimpsest.gate_b.pre_solve_canary
scripts.gate-b:instances:verify: uv run --offline --frozen --project python pytest python/tests/gate_b/test_corpus.py python/tests/gate_b/test_text_pipeline.py python/tests/gate_b/test_entities.py python/tests/gate_b/test_stationary_key.py python/tests/gate_b/test_instance_builder.py && vitest run tests/gate-b/public-projection.test.ts tests/gate-b/evidence-replay.test.ts
scripts.gate-b:baselines: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.baseline_producer --all
scripts.gate-b:identification: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.identification_producer --all
scripts.gate-b:audits: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.entity_audit --all
scripts.gate-b:solver-packets: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.solver_packets --all
scripts.gate-b:human-kits: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.human_kit_producer --all
scripts.gate-b:run-agent: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --frozen --project python --env-file .env.local python -m palimpsest.gate_b.frontier_agent_runner
scripts.gate-b:import-agent: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.solver_import --expected-condition frontier-agent-tools
scripts.gate-b:import-human: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.solver_import --expected-condition human-tools
scripts.gate-b:score: pnpm gate-b:predeclare:check && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.scoring_producer --all && uv run --offline --frozen --project python python -m palimpsest.gate_b.analysis --all
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings packages tools tests vitest.config.ts && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff check --config python/pyproject.toml python
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:versions && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:py && pnpm contracts:compare
